suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific complication. Apply only when cirrhosis/chronic liver disease is consistent with the primary biliary cholangitis/cirrhosis phenotype described by the source and osteoporosis is separately documented. Source is PBC-specific; do not generalize to every cause of cirrhosis without individual assessment. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Cirrhosis of the Liver matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Osteoporosis, Residuals of with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
